name: s3:PutBucketPolicy to an external account is policy takeover
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 105. s3:PutBucketPolicy lets the grantee rewrite the bucket's own resource policy (takeover / self-expansion), far more dangerous than a data-plane action. The generic path reports it high RESOURCE-CROSS-ACCOUNT; the S3 per-service takeover rule ADDS S3-BUCKET-POLICY-TAKEOVER (high, cross-account), naming PutBucketPolicy as takeover, ranked above data-plane, cross-account necessary-not-sufficient, never over-claimed as effective takeover.

S3-BUCKET-POLICY-TAKEOVER: does NOT prove the takeover is effective
